Build helper is unmodified. Local patch: clipboardCopy and clipboardRead in MacLocalTerminalView.swift are open instead of public so Harbor can deny remote OSC 52 clipboard access. Package.swift is reduced to macOS library plus required build-info plugin; CLI, documentation and portable PNG dependencies are omitted. No swift-subprocess dependency.
